title: Improper tilde in CDPATH causes segfault with NVIM v0.3.4

labels.name: complexity:low
labels.description: Low-risk, self-contained. Do NOT ask "can I work on this", just read CONTRIBUTING.md

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

labels.name: bug-regression
labels.description: wrong behavior that was introduced in a previous commit (please bisect)

body:
<!-- Before reporting: search existing issues and check the FAQ. -->
I am aware of old closed #2339 in 2015 but I suffered problem in 2019

This is the same bug which was reported to Debian as
https://bugs.debian.org/cgi-bin/bugreport.cgi?bug=930079

How to reproduce:
$ CDPATH=~bogus nvim -u NONE
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
$ CDPATH=~bogus nvim -u NORC
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
$ nvim --version
NVIM v0.3.4
Build type: Release

Features: +acl +iconv -jemalloc +tui 
See ":help feature-compile"

   system vimrc file: "$VIM/sysinit.vim"
  fall-back for $VIM: "/usr/share/nvim"

Run :checkhealth for more info
- Vim (version: ) behaves differently?
No problem. 
Also no problem if started as "CDPATH= nvim"
